expected_level_description: You can: - explain information security and the security controls available to protect solutions and services

You can: - support infrastructure solutions and services, and other computer, storage, networking, physical infrastructure, software, commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) software and open source packages and solutions - support virtual and cloud computing, including Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) and Software as a Service (SaaS)
You can: - explain the importance of using modern development standards
You can: - show an awareness of problem resolution processes - pass problems on to your team

You can: - investigate problems in systems, processes and services, with an understanding of the level of a problem, for example, strategic, tactical or operational - contribute to the implementation of remedies and preventative measures
You can: - assist as part of a team in the design of components of larger systems
You can: - explain the process and principles of integrating systems. - describe challenges of designing, building and testing interfaces between systems
You can: - show an awareness of the relevant subject matter and a high level understanding of what it involves
You can: - show an awareness of different technology capabilities - demonstrate basic troubleshooting capability
You can: - describe the main parts of the health and care system and the services the organisation supports - explain why patient safety and confidentiality matter in your work
You can: - follow the organisation's rules for handling personal and health information - recognise and report a data breach or near miss
You can: - explain common cyber threats such as phishing and ransomware - report a suspected security event
You can: - explain why prompt patching and secure configuration matter
